# Alternative method: Using divmod() instead of % operator
number = 34462116119303
divisor = 650

# divmod() returns (quotient, remainder) - different calculation approach
quotient, remainder = divmod(number, divisor)

# Verify: number = quotient * divisor + remainder
verification = quotient * divisor + remainder
assert verification == number, "Verification failed"

print(f"ANSWER: {remainder}")
